title: High Scores Only
instructions:
Write a function called `highScores` that takes two parameters:
- `scores` of type `List<Int>` -- a list of match scores
- `minimum` of type `Int` -- the minimum score to keep

The function should return a new `List<Int>` containing only the scores that are greater than or equal to `minimum`.

Use the `.filter` function.

Examples:
- `highScores(listOf(45, 72, 38, 91), 50)` returns `[72, 91]`
- `highScores(listOf(10, 20, 30), 25)` returns `[30]`
hint: Use scores.filter { it >= minimum } to keep scores at or above the minimum.
